|arg= global

|eff= global

|gr1= Unit Control

|descr= Assign a unit as driver of a vehicle. Used together with [[orderGetIn]] to order subordinate units to get in as driver of a specific vehicle. Before usage of this command a subordinate unit has not got the option to get into the driver place of the vehicle.
{{Feature|informative|See [[AI Group Vehicle Management]] for more information.}}

|s1= unitName [[assignAsDriver]] vehicleName

|p1= unitName: [[Object]]

|p2= vehicleName: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
_soldier1 assignAsDriver _tank;
[_soldier1] orderGetIn true;
</sqf>

|seealso= [[assignAsCommander]] [[assignAsGunner]] [[assignAsCargo]] [[assignAsTurret]] [[assignAsCargoIndex]] [[moveInCargo]] [[moveInCommander]] [[moveInDriver]] [[moveInGunner]] [[moveInTurret]] [[assignedVehicleRole]] [[assignedVehicle]] [[unassignVehicle]] [[leaveVehicle]] [[fullCrew]]
